pages.title: Prestige
lines: &8Reach your level cap to earn your next prestige.
&fFastest now: T6 Legendary, +45% TP per kill.
pages.notes: Home has no buttons; the body only. Ready variant replaces the 6th line with '&aReady to prestige.'; system off shows '&cPrestige system is disabled. Ask staff to turn it on.' instead of lines 4-7. Lines 5 and 6 say the same thing twice ('Reach your level cap...' then 'Reach level 150,000 first.'). Footer: first tab = Home, one right-side 'Back to main menu'.

pages.title: Prestige
lines: &7Prestige favor - exchange current prestige on the Shop tab (loses the stat bonus).
pages.notes: Not-ready state shown (worst case). Raw label 'Reach level 150,000 first' is 25 chars and clips to 'Reach level 150,000...' (limit 22). The dim button still sends page:confirm (not nav:none). Ready state: same cell, label 'Prestige now', style danger. Exchange line only when the exchange is enabled.

mock.why: openTurnIn: the dim label "Reach level 150,000 first" is clipped by the 6 px/character estimate although it fits the 198 px button

pages.title: Prestige
lines: &6&lNotice &eThis resets your stats, skills, techniques and quest progress, and adds one to your current prestige amount. Kept skill levels and permanent shop purchases survive.
&cYou are a God of Destruction - prestiging will remove you from your universe role.
&cYou are a Supreme Kai - prestiging will remove you from your universe role.
pages.notes: Worst case: both universe-role warnings (in practice a player holds one). Not ready: adds '&cReach your level cap before you can prestige.' and no Confirm button. Page title line is a plain &7 label, not a header.

pages.title: Prestige
pages.notes: Six single left-column buttons, one per row (right column empty). Each section button is hidden when switched off in config; 'Special perks' is cfg.customShop.menuLabel and is hidden while no perk is enabled or owned (both default entries ship disabled, so by default it is absent).

mock.why: openShop: six shop buttons each alone in the left column (half the page empty). Pair them in two columns.

pages.title: Prestige
lines: &cExchanging prestige for Prestige favor removes the stat bonus.
&7Bulk: 3 for 4 favor, 6 for 8 favor, 9 for 13 favor, 12 for 18 favor, 15 for 23 favor, or 18 for 28 favor.
pages.notes: Default packs 1,2,3,6,9,12,15,18, player holds 7. Dim packs: the intended label 'Exchange 9 - hold 9 first' is 25+ chars for every pack, so it always falls back to 'Exchange N' and the reason never shows. Dim cells still send page:ask:turnin:N (ask page explains). Exchange closed: '&8The exchange is closed right now.' and no buttons.

pages.title: Prestige
pages.notes: Default skill ids meditation, fly, sprint, jump, potentialunlock (maxes 10/10/10/10/30). A per-skill price tag ' (N)' is added only when it differs from the header price. 'Potential Unlock 12/30' is exactly 22 chars. Maxed skills are dim but still open the ask page. Header line is built from config (levelsPerPurchaseOverrides).

pages.title: Prestige
lines: &7Difficulty tiers - buy in order, activate with coins.
&8Pick a tier to see its price before you buy.
pages.notes: Seven single left-column rows. Default costs (n+1)/2 favor: 1,1,2,2,3,3,4. Other tails: 'Not for sale' ('T6 Legendary - Not for sale' is 27 chars, falls back to 'T6 - Not for sale'). Dim rows still open the ask page.

mock.why: openTiers: seven tier buttons each alone in the left column; pair them like Difficulty > Tiers does.

pages.title: Prestige
lines: &7Majin / Mutant - 5 favor. One at a time.
&7Ultimate - 3 favor. Permanent, stacks with Majin and Mutant.
pages.notes: State shown: owns Majin (exclusive with Mutant), Ultimate on sale. Other cells: 'Buy Majin'/'Buy Mutant' confirm, 'Remove Mutant' danger, 'Ultimate owned' / 'Already unlocked' dim. Those two dim Ultimate cells send page:effects (a reload), not nav:none like lockedButton. The Ultimate line is added after the Majin/Mutant buttons were placed, so it renders in the body above all buttons, away from its own button.

pages.title: Prestige
lines: &71 favor buys 10 points. 1 point adds 50 mastery to a form you have unlocked.
&7God Ki Mastery: 10 points a level, open to everyone.
&8Favor spent on points is not refunded, and neither is applied mastery.
pages.notes: Packs from MasteryWallet.FAVOR_PACKS {1,2,5,10}; unaffordable packs are dim (same action). Not selling: packs replaced by line '&8Points are not on sale right now. Points you have can still be applied.' (added after buttonsAfterLines). 'Apply points to a form' is exactly 22 chars.

pages.title: Prestige
lines: &7Pick a line. God Ki Mastery is open to everyone; the other lines list forms you have unlocked.
pages.notes: 8 lines a page (MASTERY_PICKS_PER_PAGE), single left column, then Prev/Next (Next alone sits in the LEFT slot on page 1). Group tokens are samples. 'Legendary Super Saiyan (3 forms)' does not fit, so the count is dropped; 'Ultra Instinct (2 forms)' is 24 chars and would also fall back to 'Ultra Instinct'. Divine Ki appears only after God Ki is mastered. Empty state: two &7 lines and no buttons.

mock.why: openMasteryLines: eight form lines each alone in the left column, then a lone Next; pair them and give the pager its own row ("Page 1 of 2 | Next page").

pages.title: Prestige
lines: &7Pick a form. Each point adds 50 mastery, up to the form's cap.
footerLabels: Back to Apply points to a
pages.notes: Form buttons 'label current/cap' fall back to the bare label when over 22 chars, so most forms lose their numbers ('Super Saiyan 1,200/2,500' is 24 -> 'Super Saiyan'); the capped suffix ' - at cap' is also dropped ('Super Saiyan 2' dim). Footer: parent page title 'Apply points to a form' is too wide for 'Back to ...' and backTo() drops the last word, giving 'Back to Apply points to a'. Up to 8 forms + Prev/Next.

pages.title: Prestige
lines: &7Up to 94 points fit. Each button shows the mastery you end with.
pages.notes: Amounts from APPLY_AMOUNTS {1,5,10,25,50,100} that fit, plus the exact 'all that fit' amount. Max is 7 buttons (4 rows) when 100 fits and the remainder is extra. God Ki/Divine Ki form uses godKiFormSpec: lines '&7God Ki Mastery &fLevel 3/10', '&7God Ki mastery &f3,000 / 10,000', points, cost explanation, and ONE button 'Level up (10 points)' (dim 'Top level reached' at max).

pages.title: Prestige
pages.notes: Default config entries (shown as if staff enabled them). Caption 'Vitality Training - 3 favor' (27) and 'Saiyan Pride 1 - 3 favor' (24) are over 22 chars, so the price drops and only the name shows: the list never shows a price for any perk name longer than ~12 chars. One single left-column row per perk, no paging (a long perk list grows unbounded). Empty: '&8Nothing for sale right now. Ask staff to stock the shop.'

pages.title: Prestige
lines: &8Example: +10% Strength per level, up to 3 levels. Turn Enabled on to sell it.
pages.notes: Buy label puts the price in bare parentheses '(3)' with no unit (favor). The default description tells players to 'Turn Enabled on' (a config field) if staff enable the sample without editing. Staff also see '&cStaff: <problem>' and '&8Staff: not for sale.' lines. Single-purchase perk: Owned yes/no, 'Buy (3)', 'Remove'.

pages.title: Prestige
lines: &cExchanged prestiges lose their stat bonus. This can't be undone.
pages.notes: Representative of every ask: page (title line, label/value before->after, one warning line, a single Confirm, Back). Irreversible exchange uses the green confirm style although the line says it can't be undone. Blocked: '&c<reason>' and no Confirm. askFinish takes backPage/backLabel parameters that it no longer uses (the footer comes from the registry). Other asks skipped as layout repeats: skill, tier, majin/mutant/unmajin/unmutant, ultimate, custom_buy/custom_remove, mastery_buy, mastery_apply.

mock.why: turnInAskSpec: the page says "This can't be undone." but its button is the green confirm style; an irreversible spend is danger.

pages.title: Character Services
lines: &7Change class: &fYour class is Spiritualist. Race and stats stay.
&7Customize model: &fEquipped: Antennas2, Horns5. Swap the parts on your head.
&7Body parts: &f3 pieces equipped. Unlock and wear tails, wings, horns and more.
&7Reskin: &fChange your hair, eyes and colors. Race, class and stats stay.
&7Preview forms: &fSee your race in each of its forms on the model. Nothing changes on you.

rows.label: Spin model
rows.note: label is 'Stop spin' while the model spins

pages.notes: Model box 248,60,86,120 with the spin toggle fixed under it (x248 y184 w86); the flow rows start below the toggle (row 208). Race shown blocked by cooldown: its index line uses &7 with no value color and its button is dim but still sends page:race:0. Preview forms line + button are staff-only; a player gets 5 lines and Reskin alone on the last row. labelValue('Healing:', ...) puts a colon in the label, unlike every other labelValue. Healing line only when HealCap.summary is non-null.

pages.title: Character Services
lines: &7Pay Ancient Coins to replay one saga.
&6&lNotice &eClears that saga's progress. This cannot be undone.
pages.notes: 8 sagas a page (DISCOVERY_PER_PAGE), 2-up, then Prev/Next (Next alone in the left slot on page 1). Saga ids/names are samples. A status caption that does not fit drops the status entirely ('Android Saga - In progress' is 26 -> 'Android Saga'), so that dim button no longer says why it is dim. Dim cells still send page:saga_confirm (not nav:none). Tab id 'saga' maps to page reset:0. Saga reset off: '&c<RESET_OFF>' and no buttons.

mock.why: openSagaReset: the saga buttons open a confirm page, so they are normal, not green confirm; "Android Saga - In progress" is cut to "Android Saga" (dim with no reason) by the 6 px/character estimate although it fits 198 px.

pages.title: Character Services
lines: &7Reset Frieza Saga progress? This costs 850 Ancient Coins and cannot be undone.
pages.notes: Only confirm page in Character Services without a title line ('Confirm ...'); body is the SagaResetService confirm sentence, all forced to &7 by appendCompactLines. In a quest party adds '&7Leave your quest party before resetting.' (still shows the Confirm button). Not ready: '&c<reason>' and no button.

pages.title: Character Services
lines: &7Convert to Android: Android forms replace your Super and Legendary forms.
&8Priced by level: 1 Gold coin, plus 1 per 100 levels. Removing Android later is free.
pages.notes: ELIGIBLE state. The cost line reads 'Cost 16x Gold Ancient Ancient Coins' (formatExactCost already ends in 'Ancient', costLine appends 'Ancient Coins'). UPGRADED state: lines 'Remove Android forms and restore your previous look.', 'Cost &afree', notice 'Click again within 10 seconds. Converting to Android deletes Super and Legendary forms. Removing Android restores their skills.' and a danger 'Remove Android' that runs do:android_remove directly (click-twice flow, no confirm page, unlike Convert). Other states: one or two text lines and no button. 'Another player' is staff only.

pages.title: Character Services
lines: &6&lNotice &eConverting replaces your Super and Legendary forms with Android forms. Removing Android later is free and restores them.
pages.notes: Same double-'Ancient' cost line. Staff pages android_staff / android_target / android_confirm skipped as layout repeats (picker 20 a page 2-up; target page one button; confirm one button). openAndroidConfirm builds an unused 'backToPlayer' action, and the registry sends android_confirm Back to the Android tab, not to the player's target page.

pages.title: Character Services
lines: &7Listed cost is for keeping 100%. 0% keep is free - pick keep % on the next screen.
&7You keep ki skills, techniques, and shared form progress.
&7Forms that only belong to your old race reset if the new race cannot use them.
&8Keeping everything costs 10x Netherite Ancient - exact cost shown on the next page.
pages.notes: Up to 20 races a page (2-up, 10 rows) then Prev/Next; race ids are titleCased ids from DMZ discovery (samples; the server has ~12). The current race is dim and still opens its confirm page. Body repeats the keep-0%-is-free / keep-100% cost fact three times (Keep 0% Free, 'Listed cost...', the pinned dim line). appendCompactLines forces every service line to &7, so the green 'Ready to use' cooldown line loses its color. Cost text 'Netherite Ancient' (no 'Coins').

pages.title: Character Services
lines: &7Purchased looks carry over. Your class stays if the new race has it.
&7If not, the editor opens so you can pick a class at no extra cost.
&7If the change fails, your coins are returned when possible.
pages.notes: 13 keep steps (default 0-100 by 10 plus 25 and 75) = 7 rows; the selected step is green confirm, others normal; then one Pay row (label 'Pay <compact cost>' or 'Confirm' when free). Prices are samples (100% = 1,000,000 copper). The irreversible warning 'Staff cannot undo this for you.' is DANGER in CharacterServicesGuiApi but appendCompactLines re-colors it &7, so it reads like any other line; the Pay button is green. Race and Keep are each shown twice (labelValue + 'You are becoming'/'Keeping' lines). The race_confirm line uses FightingClassLabels.display (a class helper) to name the race.

mock.why: openRaceConfirm: eleven keep-% buttons (0, 10, 20 ... 100) make the page 559 px tall; offer 0 / 25 / 50 / 75 / 100 (the Diamond-priced 25% and 75% already exist).

pages.title: Character Services
lines: &7Pick a class for your current race.
&7Only classes that fit your current race are listed.
&7Your base combat stats stay - class skills and progression reset.
pages.notes: Up to 20 classes a page, 2-up, Prev/Next. The current class is dim yet still opens its confirm page. Class confirm (class_confirm:<id>) skipped as a layout repeat: title line, 'New class: X', 2 dim lines, pinned Cost, one 'Pay 2 Emerald' confirm button.

pages.title: Character Services
lines: &7One piece from each group. Demon horns can be worn together.
&7A locked part charges Ancient Coins when you turn it on.

rows.label: Spin model
rows.note: label is 'Stop spin' while the model spins

pages.notes: Model box 248,60,86,120 + fixed spin; flow starts below the toggle. Page 0 'Head' has 6 parts, page 1 'Horns' has 8 (horns1-5, majin1-3) so 4 card rows there. Part names come from prettyId of the ids, so players see 'Ears1', 'Antennas2', 'Majin3' (id-style names with digits) unless staff set displayNames. Body says a locked part 'charges Ancient Coins when you turn it on' but clicking it opens a confirm page first. Page is named 'Customize model' on Home/registry and 'Model customization' in its own text and the Monkey message.

pages.title: Character Services
lines: &7Body parts 1/9 &fOn: Saiyan Tail, Wings Feather, Demongod Breastplate Extra Long
&7Extra pieces for your KaiPath model preview - wings, horns, tails.
&7A locked piece charges Ancient Coins when you turn it on.
&7Shown on model previews; unlocked pieces stay in your collection.
&7Locked pieces show their price. Tap one to see it on you before you pay.

rows.label: Spin model
rows.note: label is 'Stop spin' while the model spins

pages.notes: Filters are explicit 98px buttons at x 16/122/228 (8px apart), current filter green. 8 cards a page (2-up) then Prev/Next, then Clear parts | Part colors. Part ids/names/prices are samples (names from the self-test). Locked cards cut the name with '..' so the price fits ('Demongod.. 12 Emerald'; 'Spirit orbs buffed' -> 'Spirit or.. 12 Emerald'). An equipped card whose ' - Equipped' does not fit drops the state. Body text names the client mod ('KaiPath model preview') to players, and lines 3 and 5 overlap. 'Find a part' button vs page title 'Find a body part'.

pages.title: Character Services
pages.notes: Text field input:bodypart_query x16 w318 (PANEL_W-32; wider than the 306 two-column span, so its right edge does not line up with the buttons), max 32 chars, placeholder 'e.g. horns'. Search is bound to the field. Up to 5 recent searches 2-up; a recent query too long for 'Recent: ' drops the prefix and shows the clipped query alone. Up to 8 matches a page (cap 40). 'Wings Feather - Equipped' is 24 chars so the equipped card shows only 'Wings Feather' (green). Client without text input: one line 'Typing a search needs a newer KaiPath client. Pick a group instead:' and the 6 filter buttons. No model on this page.

pages.title: Character Services
lines: &7Pick a color for each part channel - own, trim, horn, glow.
&7Your choice follows you in every form.
&7Reset returns a channel to your form's default colors.

rows.label: Spin model
rows.note: label is 'Stop spin' while the model spins

pages.notes: Each row is two buttons with the SAME action (name + current value); the value cell is dim when 'Default', which reads as disabled though it is clickable. Body text lists the internal channel keys ('own, trim, horn, glow') while the buttons say Part/Trim/Horn/Glow color. 'Part colors' page has no title line.

pages.title: Character Services
lines: &7Or pick any color: tap the wheel or type a hex like #e23b3b, then Apply.

rows.label: Spin model
rows.note: label is 'Stop spin' while the model spins

pages.notes: 16 presets, 8 a page (2 pages). Crimson/Orange/Gold hex values not looked up (placeholders in angle brackets). Hex field x16 w150 (max 9 chars, placeholder '#rrggbb', a color square previews it) with 'Apply this color' bound to it on the same row; the color wheel (LM client only) is its own row, x16, size 56. KaiPath without the wheel: line 3 reads 'Or pick any color: type a hex like #e23b3b, then Apply.'; no text input: 'Typed fields need KaiPath 1.3.9 or newer. Until then pick a swatch.' and no field row. Registry title for bodycolors:** is 'Part color' (singular) while the parent is 'Part colors'.

pages.title: Character Services
lines: &7Ancient Coins &fCopper 12 - Iron 3 - Gold 64 - Emerald 17 - Diamond 2 - Netherite 1
&7Unlocks Wings Feather for good and turns it on. You can turn it off any time.
&8Unlocks survive race changes. Coins spent are not refunded.
&8The model shows Wings Feather on you.

rows.label: Spin model
rows.note: label is 'Stop spin' while the model spins

pages.notes: Model shows the candidate part (preview snapshot). Cost reads '12x Emerald Ancient' while the button says 'Pay 12 Emerald'. Cannot afford: a long red AncientCoinEconomy.missingText line and no Pay button. bone_ask is the same layout ('Confirm look unlock', 'Look'). openUnlockAsk computes a backLabel ('Find parts' / 'Body parts' / 'Model customization') it never uses; registry parent is bodyparts:0 even when opened from the find screen.

pages.title: Character Services
lines: &7Use Model customization for cross-race ears, horns, and more.
&7Reskin only changes how you look. To change your fighting class, use Change class instead.
&7Price scales with level (1500) - base 1x Gold Ancient -> you pay 3x Gold Ancient
&7You'll be charged Ancient Coins when you confirm on the next screen.
pages.notes: First line is printed twice: openReskin adds it, then appendCompactLines adds the same sentence from CharacterServicesGuiApi.linesForPage('reskin') (not in the skip list). Cost line has the double 'Ancient Ancient Coins'. 'Review cost' button although the cost is already on this page. Reskin confirm (reskin_confirm) skipped as layout repeat: 'Confirm reskin' + service lines + one 'Pay 3 Gold' button; when blocked, the precheck reason is printed twice (once from linesForPage, once as the red line in openReskinConfirm).

pages.title: Character Services
lines: &7Previous and Next step through your race's forms. Nothing changes on you and nothing is unlocked.
&8The model wears your own colors, hair and skin, in this form.

rows.label: Spin model
rows.note: label is 'Stop spin' while the model spins

pages.notes: Staff only. Big model box 190,46,144,186 (scaled to fit giant forms); spin toggle fixed at x219 y236 w86 without clearing the flow. Previous/Next are 80px at x16 and x100 (4px apart, tighter than the 6px gap elsewhere). Labels 'Previous' here vs 'Prev' on every other pager. KaiPath client: last line '&8The model uses the race's default colors, not your own.' Non-staff / no character: two &7 lines and no buttons.
